# SmartPresence

> SmartPresence is a school management platform for teachers, students, parents, attendance, notices and reports, with AI face recognition that takes classroom attendance from a single photo.

The signed-in portals for super admins, school admins, teachers and parents are private and not meant for crawling.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.smartpresence.tech/): what SmartPresence does, how it works, features and FAQ
- [Docs](https://www.smartpresence.tech/docs): how a school is onboarded, step by step, and what each role can do
- [Status](https://www.smartpresence.tech/status): live status of the platform and any scheduled maintenance
- [Privacy policy](https://www.smartpresence.tech/privacy-policy): what data is collected and how it is used
- [Sign in](https://www.smartpresence.tech/login): login for schools, teachers and parents
